page.layout: One blank page. No printed text blocks, no margins with text. Only show-through from the reverse side and marks in the paper.
page.notes: Faint mirrored text at the top, centre and lower centre is show-through from the other side and is not transcribed. The reddish marks at the right margin, around the middle of the page, look like handwriting or a stamp and are not printed text, so they are not transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
